plan.config: the 50 Phase A settings (5 band types x 10 win chances), round i on setting i mod 50: 2 of each per epoch
plan.seedRule: 5 player-set seeds, one per epoch ("pfaudit-prod-dice-d<k>-" + 12 hex of the browser CSPRNG)

plan.config: 1 % win chance (99x) in the four modes under / over / inside / outside, 50 each, round i on mode i mod 4 (outside alternates its excluded band in the lower / upper half)
plan.seedRule: "audit" + 12 hex of the browser CSPRNG, a fresh one per epoch
plan.floor: Phase A >= 50 bets per config class, both ends of the range (DICE-15): 4 modes x 50 at 1 % = 200

runner.bandGenerator: inside / outside positions from crypto.getRandomValues (rejection-sampled), on the 0.01 grid

plan.seedRule: "audit" + 12 hex of the browser CSPRNG, a fresh one per epoch
plan.floor: Phase C >= 100 bets at elevated stake (DICE-12)

conversion.layout: the capture files in the order listed in meta.captures; epochs renumbered 0..N-1 across them (seed / bet `epoch`), each keeping `capture` (the file index) and `captureEpoch` (the epoch number in that file)
conversion.phases: bet / seed `phase` = the phase letter the runner recorded; `phaseId` = the runner's phase id (A+ is the Phase A top-up at 1 % win chance); the 7 Nov file predates phase ids and its rounds get phaseId A; meta.phases is counted from the files (rounds and epochs per phase id, the one served stake of the phase)
conversion.seedRecords: one per epoch: clientSeed, hashedServerSeed, nextHashedServerSeed, nonceStart from the rotation reply that opened the epoch (the first epoch of a file: the rotation that closed that file's pre-capture pair), serverSeed from the rotation reply that closed it; at = the opening rotation, revealedAt = the closing one; nonceEnd = the last nonce recorded in the epoch; plannedBets = the runner's plan for the epoch; submittedClientSeed, drawnAfter, playerSet = the runner's record of the seed it submitted with the opening rotation, the commitment it held (already served by the site) when it submitted it, and its Phase D player-set mark; an audit seed is drawn at that moment, a Phase D seed was drawn when the plan was built and is only submitted then; commitVerified = sha256(serverSeed) === hashedServerSeed and chainLinkOk = nextHashedServerSeed === the hash the closing rotation made active, both recomputed by the converter
conversion.runner: meta.captures[].runner = the runner's own description in the file's meta event: its client-seed generator, endpoints, win chances, band types, band-position generator, pacing and plan rows (the 7 Nov file predates plan rows: one row from its plan summary)
conversion.preCapture: per capture file (meta.captures[].preCapture): the pre event (active pair read before any bet of that file) and the rotation that revealed it; commitVerified recomputed by the converter

bets.served: id = betId; params = servedParams; nonce, clientSeed, serverSeedId, hashedServerSeed (= serverSeedHash) as served in the place-bet reply; roll, win, multiplier = the served outcome; result = the served wager result; betAmount (= stake), winningAmount, stakeWallet, winningAmountWallet = the served 8-dp strings, unchanged
bets.recorded: at, phase, phaseId and the epoch (captureEpoch) = the runner's record of the round
bets.verifier: LIQD's own verify endpoint reply for the round (POST /api/v1/originals/dice/verify with the revealed seed, the last HTTP 200 reply stored): at = receivedAt, request = the sent body, outcome = the reply body's outcome, parsed from the stored text

recomputed.localRoll: src/rng.ts diceRoll(revealed seed, clientSeed, nonce) / src/config.ts SCALE
recomputed.verified: localRoll === served roll && localWin === served win (exact)

bets.notProduced: no credit / wallet self-check flags (the package scores the credit itself); no wallet balance (none in any prod dice reply)

metaNotProduced.limits: no odds / bet-limit config served in the prod dice replies
metaNotProduced.epochSize: epochs differ in size across phases; see seeds[].plannedBets
